hooks.command: bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; inp=$(cat); if [ -z "$inp" ]; then inp="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; fi; path=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | tr -d "\r" | tr "\134" "/"); if printf "%s" "$path" | grep -qE "(^|/)(dist|build|[.]next|node_modules|coverage|target|vendor)/"; then echo "Blocked: edit to a generated directory ($path)" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; inp=$(cat); if [ -z "$inp" ]; then inp="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; fi; cmd=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" | tr -d "\r"); case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) n=$(printf "%s" "$cmd" | wc -c | tr -d " "); if [ "$n" -gt 6500 ]; then echo "Blocked: a ${n}-byte command - on a Windows/Git-Bash host the Bash transport corrupts a command past a fixed offset near 7.5 KB (measured): write the payload to a file (Write tool) and run it by path, or split the call" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|([:space:]])cat[[:space:]][^|;&]*>>?[[:space:]]*[^&[:space:]][^|;&]*[^<]<<[^<]|(^|[;&|([:space:]])cat([[:space:]][^|;&]*)?[^<]<<[^<][^|;&]*>>?[[:space:]]*[^&[:space:]]|[^<]<<[^<][^|]*[|][[:space:]]*tee[[:space:]]|(^|[;&|([:space:]])tee([[:space:]][^|;&]*)?[^<]<<[^<]"; then echo "Blocked: a cat/tee heredoc with a file target - documents go through the Write tool; a script goes to a scratchpad file run by path" >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$cmd" in *cd*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; c="${cmd#"${cmd%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; case "$c" in cd|cd[[:blank:]]*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; q=$(printf "\047"); d=$(printf "\042"); b=$(printf "\134"); k=$(printf "\140"); nl=$(printf "\nx"); nl="${nl%x}"; r="${c#cd}"; r="${r#"${r%%[![:blank:]]*}"}"; g=""; x=""; case "$r" in "$q"*) t="${r#"$q"}"; case "$t" in *"$q"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; t="${t%%"$q"*}"; r="${r#"$q$t$q"}";; "$d"*) t="${r#"$d"}"; case "$t" in *"$d"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; t="${t%%"$d"*}"; r="${r#"$d$t$d"}"; x=1;; *) t="${r%%[[:space:];&|<>()]*}"; r="${r#"$t"}"; g=1; x=1;; esac; r="${r#"${r%%[![:blank:]]*}"}"; case "$r" in ""|"&&"*|";"*|"$nl"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$t" in *"$q"*|*"$d"*|*"$b"*) exit 0;; esac; if [ -n "$g" ]; then case "$t" in "~") t="$HOME";; "~/"*) t="$HOME/${t#"~/"}";; esac; [ -n "$t" ] || t="$HOME"; fi; if [ -n "$x" ]; then shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null; p=$(printf "%s" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" | tr "\134" "/"); if [ -n "$p" ]; then t="${t//"\${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/$p}"; t="${t//"\$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/$p}"; fi; if [ -n "$HOME" ]; then t="${t//"\${HOME}"/$HOME}"; t="${t//"\$HOME"/$HOME}"; fi; fi; case "$t" in ""|"-"|*"$"*|*"$k"*) exit 0;; esac; here=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | jq -r ".cwd // empty" | tr -d "\r"); [ -n "$here" ] || here="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; here=$(printf "%s" "$here" | tr "\134" "/"); here=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$here" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); [ -n "$here" ] || exit 0; r=$([ -n "$g" ] || set -f; IFS=; CDPATH= cd -- "$here" 2>/dev/null && CDPATH= cd -- $t 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); [ "$r" = "$here" ] && exit 0; echo "Blocked: a leading cd ($t) moves the session cwd for every later call - keep it: absolute paths, git -C DIR, a tool dir flag, or a subshell ( cd DIR && ... ); a cd into the cwd itself passes" >&2; exit 2'
bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | tr -d "\r"); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac'
